questions.q: Which two views should read zero every morning?
o: All Open (SLA) and Resolved — Last 30 Days
Open cases (by status) and the Command Centre
questions.e: Unowned cases means somebody has to claim it; Overdue cases means it has to be cleared or escalated. When both read zero, the queue is under control.

questions.q: Where do most cases come from?
o: Ops types every one in by hand
They are auto-created from inbound sales@ mail every 15 minutes on weekdays
The salesperson creates them from the Opportunity
They are imported nightly from Intact
questions.e: An automation reads the sales@ mailbox every 15 minutes on weekdays and opens one case per mail thread from a known customer contact, with Received at set to the real arrival time.

questions.q: What are the four non-negotiables on every open case?
o: Owner, status, next action, due date
Status, resolution note, due date, escalated flag
questions.e: One named owner, one current status, one next action and one due date. Everything else is helpful; those four are the standard.

questions.q: What stamps the Acknowledged at, First response at and Resolved at timestamps on a case?
o: You type them in when you have a moment
Moving the case Status — the workflow stamps them automatically
The Ops Pulse email at 08:00 and 18:00
The salesperson when they review the account
questions.e: Moving the status is the whole action. Acknowledged stamps Acknowledged at, In Progress stamps First response at, Resolved stamps Resolved at. They are stamped once and never overwritten.
